summary: SiteDocument represents documents associated with a site in HSPnet. It is mainly used as a data structure for linking documents to site records.
purpose: To associate documents with sites in the system, allowing retrieval and management of those documents based on SiteID.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: The site to which this document is linked.

content_gaps: No workflow, business logic, validations, or actors described.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is an ASP.NET page that presents staff/admin users with a welcome dashboard, recent login information, and error/warning panels.
purpose: To provide staff/admin users an entry point with access to site and discipline filtering, error/warning messages, and last login details.

fields.name: LastLogin
fields.description: Timestamp and timezone for the last login.

workflows.name: Dashboard Initialization
steps: Setup HSPnet page using Master and FooterLabel reference.
Register required JavaScript.
Update labels with user session and login info.
Fill dropdowns for site and discipline using session context.
Show error/warning panels if applicable.

validations: RequiredFieldValidator on end date and start date.
conditions: Show error and warning if applicable; show last login if available.
system_behavior: Auto-generated fields for ASP.NET controls; conditional rendering of panels.
content_gaps: No explicit business rules, calculations, or exception handling described.

summary: ServiceCode defines a code representing a service, with support for localization and sorting.
purpose: To catalog and provide lookup for service codes used in scheduling, reporting, and grouping in HSPnet.

workflows.name: ServiceCode List/Lookup
steps: Listing all service codes for a session.
ServiceCode lookup by CourseID and TimetableID.

business_rules: Localization: Use alternate language fields when session specifies alt language.
system_behavior: Returns lists for lookup, supports localization.
content_gaps: No actors, validations, or exception handling described.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks changes to site profiles, including who made the changes, the date, section affected, and user/agency details.
purpose: To audit modifications of site profiles and provide detailed change history per site.

workflows.name: Audit Change
steps: User triggers site profile update.
Record captures change details (fields, agency, user, date).
TooltipDetails provides formatted summary for UI.

business_rules: If ByUserSysAdmin is false and users differ, show support team label.
system_behavior: Maintains history; provides formatted fields for UI display.
content_gaps: No explicit exception handling, system events, or validation logic.

summary: EmailPopupDocument represents a document used in email popups, supporting search and deletion within the user's email context.
purpose: To provide a mechanism for tracking and managing documents attached to emails, including file deletion and folder operations.

workflows.name: Search and Delete Email Document
steps: Search retrieves documents matching DataInfo.
Delete removes file and folder (if applicable), updates internal state.

business_rules: Delete removes both file and folder if possible.
system_behavior: Handles file system operations for email attachments.
exceptions: Catch blocks on file and directory deletion do not propagate errors.
content_gaps: No error reporting for failed deletions; no advanced workflow.

summary: CostCentre module manages placement cost centres, capturing financial and organizational fields related to placements.
purpose: To retrieve, track, and report on placement cost centre data, including allocation and summary of costs and hours across agencies, disciplines, sites, and other entities.

workflows.name: Placement Cost Centre Retrieval
steps: Call PlacementCostCentre procedure with parameters (sessionID, dates, agency, discipline, etc).
Populate CostCentreRecord with retrieved fields.
Return list for reporting or further processing.

business_rules: Parameterized search supports filtering by agency, discipline, site, service, etc.
Records must be populated with all relevant fields per placement.
system_behavior: Retrieves, aggregates, and reports cost centre data for placements.
content_gaps: No business logic for cost calculation itself; no exception handling or reporting beyond raw data retrieval.

summary: ExpenseBatch handles batch operations for department-level expense claims, including addition, update, deletion, and searching.
purpose: To track, manage, and process groups of expense claims at department level.

workflows.name: Expense Batch Operations
steps: Search expense batches for a department.
Add batch with details.
Update batch status.
Delete batch.
Format batch display as 'ID - StatusDescription'.

business_rules: StatusDescription shows localized text if alt language is enabled.
Auto-generated formatted batch number based on ID and status.
system_behavior: CRUD operations for batch expense claims.
exceptions: Exception handling is minimal; errors on deletion/addition are not extensively reported.
content_gaps: No explicit business rules for allowed statuses; no validation for input values.

summary: TimetableAssessments manages student assessment schedules linked to timetables, including add/edit/delete, business logic for assessor/subject configuration, validation, and UI workflow.
purpose: To allow administrators and coordinators to manage when and how assessments occur for students on specific timetables.

workflows.name: Assessment Workflow
steps: Add/Edit/Delete timetable assessment rows.
Configure assessor, subject, assessment type/template, open/close days, and view permissions.
Validate interim/final relationship, maximums, instructor/supervisor overlap.
Render UI for add/edit; trigger modal popup for details.

business_rules: Instructor and supervisor assessments cannot overlap unnecessarily.
Assessment maximums must not be exceeded.
validations: RequiredFieldValidators for open/close days and templates.
CustomValidators for business logic (e.g., close date after today).
conditions: ScreenIsEditable is conditional on user permissions.
content_gaps: No data structure details for TimetableAssessment entity beyond UI; dependencies not described.

summary: AdHocQuery is a utility for rendering arbitrary SQL results as HTML tables.
purpose: To convert database query results into HTML tables for display, enabling flexible reporting and troubleshooting.

workflows.name: Render SQL Reader
steps: Render column names as header row.
Render each data row as table cells.
Return full HTML table string.

system_behavior: Produces HTML based on arbitrary queries.
content_gaps: No actors, no input validation, no exception handling.

summary: StudentPrerequisites manages prerequisite and health/safety compliance data for students, including immunization, health, confidentiality, and safety record updates and validations.
purpose: To track and validate that students meet all required health, safety, and confidentiality prerequisites for placement.

workflows.name: Student Prerequisite Update
steps: Validate prerequisite status for each health/safety requirement.
Update immunization, mask, confidentiality, and other fields via procedures.
Handle workflow for adding/updating student records (e.g., StudentDetailsImmunizationUpdate, StudentDetailsSafetyUpdate, StudentDetailsRespiratoryMaskUpdate, etc.).

business_rules: Each health/safety prerequisite has minimum/maximum year bounds.
Expiry dates must be valid and meet 'on or after' requirements.
All updates require validation through IsValid routine.
validations: Check that dates are within allowable ranges.
Check that required fields are not empty.
Validate expiry logic for mask tests and immunizations.
calculations: Expiry date calculations (e.g., TetanusExpiryDate calculation based on admin date).
system_behavior: Handles search and update for health/safety prerequisites.
Captures reason for failure and returns error messages.
exceptions: Errors are captured via Sess.Messages.AddError and halt processing.
content_gaps: No workflow details on how prerequisites are used to block placements; error handling is only via error messages, not exceptions.
